visual_comparison: Original eight procedural meshes remain visible. No scientifically reviewed replacement has been imported; therefore no honest source-vs-replacement visual comparison exists.
scientific_limitations: The four sourced bones are an anatomical static reference frame, not a specimen-specific joint validation.
Bone bounding boxes are not attachment landmarks and cannot provide clinical alignment error.
Illustrative ACL/PCL crossing is not measured, and apparent surface intersections are not scientific validation.
Do not infer patient-specific anatomy, ligament tension, instability or dynamic patellar tracking.
